messages:
Aisha V.: Heads-up QBR thread 1: I'm building a compact 'health odometer' slide that combines onboarding progress, top health signals, and renewal pressure. Need a single slide owner and 1-2 risk bullets each. Draft here: https://drive.redwood.ai/qbr_odometer_draft (please request access if you don't have it).

Ben M.: I'll own onboarding progress + migration timeline. Will include seat growth, staged rollouts, and outstanding blockers.

Clara S.: Taking health signals & customer sentiment. I'll surface the usage dip, NPS note, and a short customer quote for the opener.

Diego P.: I can take infra/runbook slide and write one-line exec ask. Quick risk: dedicated endpoint latency spikes tied to a recent config push; adding monitoring artifacts.

Aisha V.: Thanks. Two asks: (1) drop a one-line exec ask here by 5pm so I can add to speaker notes; (2) add any onboarding blockers as a distinct "risk" row in the odometer table (so execs see it at a glance).

Ben M.: Blocker added: ETL job lagging on large customer datasets causing delayed metrics onboarding. Workaround: bump worker timeout; permanent fix needs schema patch from data-schema team. Assigned to @Diego P. ETA: Fri.

Diego P.: Ack 1. I'll coordinate with data-schema and infra. Exec ask proposal: "Approve two-week infra burst (x4 instances) and temporary priority queue to clear onboarding backlog." Feedback?

Clara S.: That reads clear. I'll add a softer fallback for ask: "If burst not available, approve extended onboarding SLA window + customer credits for affected accounts"

CS Ops Bot: Attached: qbr_odometer_v0.pptx (https://files.redwood.ai/qbr_odometer_v0.pptx) :white_check_mark:

Aisha V.: Perfect. Can we do a 20-min dry run tomorrow 11:00am PDT to walk the script? Prefer to lock deck after that.

Ben M.: 11:00 works for me.

Clara S.: I'll join and read the customer quote live.

Diego P.: I'll be there; will surface the runbook fallback.

Aisha V.: Action list (adding here so we don't lose items):
```
- Aisha V. 1 finalize odometer layout + speaker notes (due: today 6pm)
- Ben M. 1 onboarding slide + migration timeline + ETL blocker detail (due: today 4:30pm)
- Clara S. 1 health signals + customer quote + NPS snapshot (due: today 3:30pm)
- Diego P. 1 infra slide + runbook fallback + contact data-schema (due: tomorrow 9am)
- All 1 attend 11:00am PDT dry run (tomorrow)
```

Ben M.: I'll comment in the draft once ETL details are in.

Clara S.: Dropping the customer quote now.

CS Ops Bot: Export queued: qbr_odometer_v0.1.pptx (will post when ready).

Aisha V.: If anyone makes content edits after 9pm, ping here so I can re-export before the dry run. Thanks team :pray:

Ben M.: noted.

Diego P.: +1

Clara S.: +1

Aisha V.: Closing loop: lock slides after dry run, send to execs with two-line summary and ask. Escalate here if anything stalls.

Ben M.: +1

Diego P.: +1

Clara S.: +1
